quotes.text: During D208387, a reviewer asked to keep id as the first attribute on an archive-dialog control, and the accepted checkbox used id before data-l10n-id. This is a local, explicit 2024 review preference rather than a repository-wide syntax rule: the current dialog also has a newer checkbox with class before id. Preserve the accepted ordering when touching the original control, but inspect nearby newer markup before asking for a general style change.
